messages.content:
You are revising original_code using the supplied reviews.
Return JSON with one key, code, whose value is the entire Python source string.
No Markdown fences, comments or prose. Retain both functions in original_code.
Never change choose_action: retain its goal_direction parameter and its body.
The validated seven-rule plan must still hold for every sensor state.

When both reviews say needs_revision=false, make ONLY this readability edit:
inside decide_next_move, rename its local goal_direction to selected_goal,
including every assignment and the last call argument. Copy all other lines.
Do NOT add conditions or duplicate choose_action's fallback rules.
Do NOT rename goal_direction inside choose_action.
decide_next_move must contain exactly ONE return statement, at its end:
    return choose_action(front_blocked, left_blocked, right_blocked, selected_goal)

When a review identifies a real failure, address that evidence while keeping
the original helper and the same single-return adapter contract. Never change
the benchmark thresholds or claim a failure that the measurements do not show.
